# Vault instructions

This directory is one vault. Its kind is stated in the frontmatter of 00-project/brief.md and 00-project/voice.md; here it is `study`. Only kind story permits manuscript drafting; kind study permits study notes only; kind starter is an unused template. Every request in a study vault belongs to `story-craft-research`, which declines a drafting request.

Manuscript files follow 00-project/voice.md and nothing from documentation or didactic writing rules. Other vault notes are plain working notes. Replies to the author stay reader-oriented; the voice sheet never styles a reply.
